The shortest identifier a row may carry, with a paragraph behind it, so that a
page whose file is found by the shortest name there is proves the join works at
that end of the range.

What it needs before it is any use is a second paragraph, because a file
carrying exactly one is a file that cannot show whether the order paragraphs
arrive in survives the read.

What it does with data about a person is nothing, and saying so is the point:
this paragraph exists so that a page carrying no data line and a page carrying
one are two different pages in this fixture.
